Name: Shop Anywhere
Author: SorryLate
Description:
[b]Shop Anywhere[/b]
You can access shop anywhere and anytime you want.

[b]Note[/b] : this mod is like Pelican Fiber and the menu is same, but i don't use all code from Pelican Fiber and i decided if Pelican Fiber is updated / jwdred complain about this mod, well i will delete this mod instead.

[b]Requirement :
[/b]Latest SMAPI and SDV 1.4

[b]How to use :[/b]
Access shop "B" and Others Access "N". You can change keybinding in config.json
